purpose: Future integration candidate; immutable completed SCF/gradient evaluation recovery snapshots
integration_state: not_integrated; not a prerequisite for reviewed recovery launch
checks: Full coordinate, positive gradient, energy and ordered identity preservation
Explicit units and native SCF flag required independently of downstream native assertion
Requested method fingerprint covers all nongeometry and nonatom-array resolved-request fields
Raw input-byte, worker-byte and resolved-request canonical digests separately recorded
Atomic no-clobber commit follows complete write and file fsync; directory fsync follows link
Short/zero-progress/partial writes, KeyboardInterrupt before commit, and errors/interruption after commit
Temp files preserved and ignored; malformed or corrupt committed file causes recovery refusal
No checkpoint read; no mutable latest pointer; no acceptance API
limitations: Synthetic arrays only; no new chemistry or numerical qualification
Local POSIX hardlink/fsync behavior tested; power-loss durability remains filesystem-dependent
Caller must verify actual scanner atom order/state and derive same-evaluation arrays
Source hashes and requested method are declared provenance, not loaded-runtime attestation
Recorded evaluation may be a rejected line-search trial; independent optimization and chemistry checks remain mandatory
SCF checkpoint geometry/state consistency is explicitly not established
